id.description: Lower-case words joined by hyphens. May contain a parameter such as <pos>.

stateLabel.description: A session state label such as bike_in_stand or wheel_out.<pos>.

nodeName.description: A named 3D node, view or clip.

condition.description: Keys are fact keys, tool.<tool-id> or choice.<choice-id>. All keys must match (AND), evaluated in the written order. any_of holds alternatives (OR). The value unknown matches a fact the user could not answer.

toolRef.description: A tool id, or a tool id with a condition.

toolUse.description: Three tiers. required: the step cannot be done without it. one_of: tool sets (tools.yaml, tool_sets) of which the bike needs one, depending on its part. helpful: the text mentions it as an aid.

animation.description: Either a generic motion (target, motion, direction, amount) or a named clip (clip). Always a caption.

direction.description: Which way the motion goes. clockwise and counterclockwise are seen looking at the head of the screw or knob; the caption and the text say it in words.

exit.description: Ends the flow at this point. unsafe: do not ride, find a shop (only in safety checks and inspection calls). not_covered: this bike or part is not supported yet; shop and assistant. not_needed: the repair is not needed. shop_only: a shop has to do this. show_how_from names the later step or procedure that shows how to put back what is apart; required whenever something is apart.

id.description: Unique within the step. Profiles and path ids refer to it.

skips.description: Later steps in the same sequence that this answer makes unnecessary. Only check steps; never safety checks, inspection calls or steps that set or clear a state label.

details.description: Extra lines shown only when every fact in needs is known. Facts used only here are never asked.

params.description: Flow parameters such as pos. Each value is expanded as its own run.

outcome.description: continue, an object with exactly one of block, exit, or a follow-up: { inspect, outcomes }, an inspection shown next only after this state (for example 'I cannot find it' -> 'Look along the cable'). A follow-up's own outcomes cannot have another follow-up.

plainOutcome.description: continue, or an object with exactly one of block, exit.

followOutcomes.description: Per state of a follow-up inspection: continue, block or exit.

card.description: One card (a step): a job file's cards and the shared cards in content/steps/. Its id is unique across all cards, inspections and procedures.

title.description: Short heading of the card, a few words, for example 'Check the inner limit'.

question.description: Answers are the exception: the text states the goal, Next means it is met. This short question ('Not in line?') stands above the buttons, which are only the problems. Next is never locked.

if_unknown.description: When a fact in when is unknown. ask: ask before the start; if still unknown, as include. generic: show generic_text. skip: leave the step out. include: show the step as written.

show.description: 3D parts drawn plain; focus marks the small parts in colour; the 3D view hides every other part. A name goes in one of the two lists, not both.

outcomes.description: Per state of the inspection: continue, block or exit.
